data.credibility: Larsen & Toubro generally delivers or improves on core operational metrics like working capital and order inflows, though revenue growth fell short of initial targets. Management occasionally drops or stops mentioning specific margin metrics, reflecting mixed reporting consistency across horizons.

lines.line: Promised 10% FY26 order inflow growth; delivered successfully as guided.
Promised 15% revenue growth for FY26; missed with actual 11.8%.
Targeted 12% working capital ratio; significantly outperformed, delivering 4.1%.
Targeted 8.3-8.5% EBITDA margin; delivered 12.6% but dropped mention later.
Expecting 10% to 12% FY27 order inflow growth; currently on track.
Expecting 10% to 12% FY27 revenue growth; currently on track.
Expecting stable 7.8% PP&M margin in FY27; currently on track.
Expecting 10% working capital in FY27; currently on track.
Targeted 10-12% inflow CAGR under Lakshya 31; currently pending.
Targeted 12-15% revenue CAGR under Lakshya 31; currently pending.
